messages.subject: continuously broken builds
parts:
We've defeated the purpose of continuous integration
if we come to expect the builds to fail.

Would anyone mind if I just comment out the
tests that are failing for now so that we
can see if anything we're checking in is
introducing new problems? I can add a ticket
to bug tracking to put them back in.

- Bob
